Explain the example for remove your own old caches

blocks.text: The activate event can tidy old cache versions. Use a clear prefix so your worker only removes caches it owns.

These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.

blocks.title: Remove your own old caches

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`waitUntil` tells the browser to keep this worker event active until the promise finishes.

blocks.text: Old reading-prefixed caches are removed. The two current names are kept.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not delete every cache on the origin. Another app on that origin may own a different cache.
